MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smaller caliper felt useful because I could measure screw diameters and washer openings when matching parts for my recent hardware projects.",
    "Both calipers connected with my need to fit hardware accurately, although I would only choose the smaller one for my small fasteners."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The printer filaments do not meet any current need shown by my purchases; buying fasteners and magnetic hooks does not mean I have a 3D printing project.",
    "The locking nuts seemed relevant at first, but the SAE sizes do not match my recent M3, M4, and M5 metric screws.",
    "The larger caliper serves a related purpose, but I have no clear need for its extra measuring range or for a second caliper."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat workshop supplies as interchangeable, even though printing materials serve a different task from fastening and hanging hardware.",
    "The nut assortment shares the purpose of securing bolts, but that similarity alone is not enough when the sizes do not match my parts."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases point to matching small metric fasteners, so dimensions and compatibility matter when choosing related supplies.",
    "My repeated magnetic-hook purchases suggest a current interest in hanging and organizing things, which the filament recommendations do not support.",
    "I rarely interact unless something has a clear use now; the compact caliper offers a specific next step for working with the parts I recently bought."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my hardware tasks through measuring tools, but stretched that interest into printing supplies and fasteners that do not match my recent parts."
}
